$comment: Advisories consciously accepted, read by scripts/audit-ci.mjs.
Every entry MUST carry an expiry date. A permanent exception is how a known
vulnerability becomes permanent; an expiring one forces the decision to be
made again once a fix may exist. An expired entry stops suppressing and the
build goes red, which is the intended behaviour, not a bug.
'reason' must say why the advisory is not reachable HERE — not that it is
inconvenient to fix. If the honest reason is 'no time', that is a risk
acceptance and belongs in the risk register, not in a build config.
The list is currently empty: as of the last audit the workspace has zero
known advisories, so nothing needs accepting.
